comments.text:
Two things immediately. First this needs to be completely open source. No if ands or butts about it. I need everybody to be able to open up that source code and tell me everything about how the information is being used and where it's going. Secondly is the tokenomics. Who has the tokens how many tokens, are they using it for profit, how many tokens are distributed to each person, is there an ico is there anything to prevent this from being used as speculation or simple stock in Open AI? Listen I'm all for moving power from the nation state to the people, but I'm not buying in or giving away my freedoms and identity just to have one institution be replaced by another.

comments.author: @FiatSceptic
comments.text:
00:12 Sam Altman and OpenAI are launching World Coin, a project separate from OpenAI, aimed at providing a global identification system and resources for individuals affected by AI.
00:42 World Coin is three things: an ID, money, and a global payment system.
01:10 Each unique human will have a unique World Coin account, serving as proof of their identity, allowing global transactions, and potentially assisting in the governance of AI.
01:53 The ID system uses an orb that scans your eye to generate an iris code, acting as a digital wallet and ID. The actual image of the eyeball is deleted, but the iris code is stored.
03:44 Over 2 million people have participated in the World Coin ID system.
04:12 Sam Altman, OpenAI, and other notable organizations are involved with World Coin.
04:41 Sam Altman has previously discussed the potential impact of AI and suggested the concept of universal basic income (UBI). World Coin could potentially be a means of implementing a similar concept.
05:36 The announcement for World Coin is expected on July 24, 2023, with potential significant implications for the global workforce and workplace dynamics.
06:30 World Coin could provide an all-in-one solution for governments, corporations, and individuals to adapt to the changes brought by AI and automation.
06:57 The idea of having an ID scan for crypto tokens and supporting assistance for those affected by AI job loss is discussed, and viewers are encouraged to share their opinions on these concepts.
